relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a 26-year-old man whose Danon disease was diagnosed by endomyocardial biopsy: "Electron microscopy confirmed lysosomal vacuoles and β-glycogen deposits (Fig. 3C and D), diagnostic of Danon disease".
method_note: Hand extraction; the paper is a short case report with no tables. In scope by diagnosis of Danon disease (biopsy/electron microscopy); the paper reports no genetic testing and prints no LAMP2 variant for the patient, so the variants table is empty (no variant is tied to him) and n_patients_reported (defined as patients with a LAMP2 variant) is null. The brother is included as a relative described in relation to the patient (sudden death); the paper does not say he had Danon disease or was tested. 'Hypokinesia' (CMR, 'diffuse LVH with hypokinesia') was mapped to the checklist item 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle'; no ejection fraction is given. 'Sinus rhythm' was not used to exclude supraventricular tachycardia. Statements in the Background, Discussion and abstract Conclusions about Danon disease in general (myopathy, cognitive impairment, CK) were not applied to the patient. The patient was first 'preliminarily diagnosed with ATTR-CA' before biopsy; disease_label records the final diagnosis. Normal light chains and Congo red negativity recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27). No age at onset or diagnosis is stated; 26 years is recorded as age at presentation (last evaluation). No contradictions found.
